We have deployed enterprise LLM tooling organisation-wide (Claude Enterprise) across all teams, but lack dedicated resource to drive adoption, govern use, and deliver production automations. This hire owns the AI adoption and automation delivery mandate. This is primarily an AI adoption and automation delivery role—not a data engineering role.

The engineer will work closely with Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to identify automation opportunities, build production-grade solutions, and ensure every deployment is safe, governed, and measurable.

Data pipeline engineering and Snowflake modelling sit with the data engineering team; this role uses the data platform as a consumer and integration point. The tech stack includes Azure, Power Automate, Python, the Claude API, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

The engineer operates within the AI governance framework owned by Compliance, Risk, and the DPO, contributing technical evidence and controls, not setting policy. This role can be hybrid at our office in Portimao or fully remote across Portugal.

advise the Data & AI Lead on relevant capabilities Automation Engineering Design and build production-grade automations using Power Automate, Python, and API integrations, targeting operational workflows across payments, FX, treasury, onboarding, and internal operations Build and maintain automated workflows and AI pipelines with human-in-the-loop controls, escalation paths, and audit trails Integrate LLM workflows with internal systems and third-party APIs using the Claude API or equivalent enterprise LLM APIs; provide technical evidence and control documentation to Compliance, Risk, Security, and the DPO as required Maintain awareness of AI regulatory developments, including the EU AI Act timetable, and flag implications to the Data & AI Lead and Compliance SOP & Process Redesign Work with Operations to review existing SOPs and identify where automation can reduce manual effort, error risk, or processing time Where automation is not yet appropriate, document improved manual processes that are automation-ready Measure and report on automation impact — hours saved, error reduction, throughput improvements Requirements Essential 3–6 years of hands-on software or automation engineering experience Proficiency in Python (e.g. scripting, API integration, workflow automation) Practical experience building with enterprise LLM APIs, such as Claude API, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent Experience with Power Automate or equivalent low-code/no-code automation platforms in a production context Ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate into working solutions Understanding of production controls: secrets management, versioning, observability, error handling, and rollback Strong written English (e.g. documentation, runbooks, and stakeholder communication) Preferred Experience with agentic AI patterns and multi-step LLM workflows with human oversight Background in financial services, payments, or another regulated sector Familiarity with Azure services used as integration and compute infrastructure Experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem as an integration target (Graph API, Teams, SharePoint) Awareness of AI governance frameworks and practical privacy controls for LLM deployments Benefits at VFX We offer more than just perks—we offer ownership.

If you care about building something meaningful, take pride in your work, and are motivated by impact — you’ll thrive here. Ocean is our newest frontier. We've just brought ocean freight onto the platform alongside air, in one workspace powered by the same AI, and we need people who can make that ocean data rock solid from day one.
